staff.releaseNotes:
- Store notification type and entity for Android notification center
- Register Android notification center activity
- Add Android notification center and preferences
- Add Android notification history and preferences
- Complete FCM diagnostic sender integration
- Fix FCM OAuth delivery without Firebase Admin credential URL error
- Fix Firebase Admin credential normalization for FCM
- Add in-app Push Notification Diagnostics panel (no console commands needed)
- Pre-create notification channels at app startup (fixes gap from hybrid FCM payload)
- Fix FCM notifications for closed Android apps
- Fix: notifications never worked on a device that never saw an update prompt
- Fix duplicate patient/invoice notifications; make update notifications push-based too
